items.title: Steampunk Style
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Become an engineer, show off your stylish golden limbs, or live casually all in a fancy steampunk style! Includes 10 total skins.

By Fantasize Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: Survival Scavenger Hunt
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Race to find 10 random items in a survival world. Customize each game to your preferences with a variety of settings! Work together in CO-OP or compete against your friends in VS mode.

- Singleplayer or multiplayer
- Customizable settings
- Epic survival challenge
- True scavenger hunt feel

items.title: RAINBOW HACK
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Hack like its your job!
These colorful rainbow skins are the worlds greatest hackers! Time to suit up and take on the world!

items.title: Skyblock As A Mob!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Skyblock, but you play as a mob!
Transform and morph into animals and mobs you encounter while trying to complete this skyblock world! Play as a mob by yourself or with your friends in this awesome survival challenge world!

+ By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: LUCKY BLOCK !
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Enjoy a unique lucky block survival experience within Minecraft! 

+ World
+ Random loot
+ Infinite possibilities

items.title: Chest Skyblock
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Skyblock with chests! Find a different adventure in each chest! Will you build into the sky or go explore a cave? Try your luck and see what's inside the box!

- Includes skins.
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Holiday Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Happy holidays!
Get ready to celebrate with your friends and family! Feel the holiday spirit with these festive skins!

Includes 1 free skin
- 10 holiday mob skins
- Perfect for holiday role-play
- By Pixelusion and 24 Studios

items.title: City Parkour Adventure
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Hey! Yeah, you! It's getting dark, lets sneak out and explore the city; follow me!

* 4 Sections
* Free Skin Included with Map
* Multiplayer Supportive

items.title: Trendy Pastel Teens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up in these super fun and colorful pastel outfits!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Bright designs!

items.title: Rich Gamers
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Show off your bling while being the coolest gamer out there!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Super stylish outfits!

items.title: Netherite Pyramid
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Start your survival world in this spooky netherite pyramid!

- A large pyramid, built using lots of netherite!
- Spawn near to a shulker box filled with OP tools and weapons

items.title: Cooler Teens
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Do you want to feel cool and dress in fashion? If so, role-play as one of the Cooler Teens in this hot new skin pack.
Includes:
- 12 skins
- 2 FREE skins!

items.title: Craftable City
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Craft your own city with craftable houses, mansions, shops, vehicles, cameras and much more!
- 25 Craftable city buildings

items.title: Neon Teens
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
Neon clothes and fluorescent outfits mix together on our brand new Neon Teens skin pack. Be the coolest among your friends and go neon!

By Colibri Studios

items.title: Mansion: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: Take a look at these dope mansions ranging from a simple noob mansion to a massive one with a giant garden! Can you explore all the rooms?

items.title: Crash Test Dummies 2
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
They are back and crazier than ever! Spice up your skin collection with these bright and zany characters. 

- 20 skins
- 2 free skins

items.title: Secret Mountain Refuge 2
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: Explore and make your house this second part of one amazing and beautiful Secret Mountain Refuge!

items.title: Parkour in the Stars
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: The stars are calling your name! The cosmos has laid before you a path to the golden star! The path will be filled with challenges along the way. Will you make it to the top? Only one way to find out!

items.title: Invisible Friends
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Can you imagine all the things you can do when you're invisible? Pulling pranks on your friends, walking around the town, and more? Invisible Friends has got you covered with 10 awesome skins! Have fun and wander around without leaving a trace! 

+ 10 skins
+ By iRay

items.title: Axolotl Teen Hats
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Wow, how cute! Check out these adorable axolotl themed hats! Rock these modern outfits and show the world the power of these adorable hats!

+ 10 unique, trendy skins
+ Perfect for kids and teens
+ Designed by Xenon Design

items.title: Mobs in Suits
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
You know it's serious when they put on the suits and ties. Well, now the mobs mean business, and business is boomin'. Step aside for the mobs in suits!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Business casual attire inspired by mobs!

items.title: Pastel Essence
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
The essence of pastel fashion styles is to dress in light colors. Chill and cool to the max!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and casual attire inspired by pastel artworks!

items.title: City Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
It's time to take to the city streets! Dress up in any of the 12 cute teen skins and show off to your friends.

+ 12 skins perfect for roleplay

items.title: Winter Shelter
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Brave the frozen north with the latest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Skeptics have long held that sustained life within the frozen reaches of the land is impossible. With biospheres and resources in hand, you've arrived in inhospitable lands to prove that a new home can be made here. Now time to prove your capabilities!
